## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `adopt` entries should be fixed so the command stops emitting each adoption message twice: `plan` already emits the message and `run` now emits it again from the returned entry.

## Changes
`plan` now appends an `adopt` entry for each setting already present and a trailing `audit` entry carrying the incoming count; two tests cover the audit entry through `run`. The pull request also adds `app/review.txt`, a one-line text file that no code references.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Stop emitting each adoption message twice from run — `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` emits `Adopted theme` twice: `plan` emits it at line 8, and the new `adopt` entry reaches the loop at `app/cli.py:9`, which skips only `audit`. No test calls `run` with an adopted setting. — Command users see every adopted setting reported twice, and no test fails for it. — Fix: Skip `adopt` entries alongside `audit` at `app/cli.py:7`, or drop the direct `emit` at `app/planner.py:8` if callers of `plan` alone do not need progress output, and extend `tests/test_planner.py` with a `run` adoption case.
